{{recipe}}

'''Fattoush''' is a Lebanese salad, good for hot weather. The recipe uses two unusual ingredients: [[Cookbook:Sumac|sumac]] and [[Cookbook:Purslane|purslane]]. Ground sumac consists of the red sumac berries, and it used in Middle Eastern, particularly Lebanese, cooking. Purslane is a succulent with a lemony flavor, and it makes a nice salad green.
==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* ⅓ cup [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Sumac|sumac]] powder
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* Ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] to taste
* 1 head [[Cookbook:Romaine Lettuce|romaine lettuce]], torn into bite-size pieces
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 2 large [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], diced
* 4 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ¼ cup chopped fresh flat-leaf [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
* ¼ cup chopped fresh [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]]
* 1 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], seeded and chopped
* 1 cup chopped [[Cookbook:Purslane|purslane]]
* ½ package (5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Arugula|arugula]] (rocket)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Pita|pita]] rounds, toasted and torn into pieces

==Procedure==
#Mix the water and cornstarch in a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium-high heat until thickened. 
#Remove from heat, and mix in lemon juice, garlic, sumac, salt, and pepper. 
#Refrigerate until ready to use.
#In a large bowl, toss together the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, green onions, parsley, mint, bell pepper, purslane, and arugula. 
#Toss with the dressing, and serve with pita.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If purslane is unavailable, [[Cookbook:Watercress|watercress]], parsley, or [[Cookbook:Arugula|arugula]] may be substituted.
